d:
Beti ki shadi ki taiyariyon ke bich anant sinh ka dikha ekdam desi aur dabang andaj! pili shart, gale men lal gamchha aur sir par kali topi pahankar anant sinh ghoron ki praiktis dekhne pahunche.
Beti ki shadi ko khas banane ke lie ho rahi taiyariyon men ghoron ka yah aayojan bhi aakarshan ka kendr bana huaa hai.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
